title: Palace declares holidays in 3 towns for local celebrations

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Malacañang has declared special non-working days in three municipalities to allow residents to celebrate their respective founding anniversaries and local occasions. Proclamation No. 1524, series of 2026, declares Dec. 4 (Friday) a special non-working day in Vintar, Ilocos Norte. The declaration aims to provide the people of Vintar with the opportunity to fully participate in and celebrate the municipality’s special occasion. Meanwhile, Proclamation No. 1525, series of 2026, declares Dec. 11 (Friday) a special non-working day in San Jose, Batangas, as the town marks its 260th founding anniversary.
